summary: No reachable vulnerability. Trust boundary (IndexedDB session records): parseSessionRecord still runs assertChips over every seat except a cash user on 0, so a tampered or stopped sit-and-go record with any seat on 0, a cash bot on 0, a negative/fractional/unsafe stack, or rebuys outside 0..MAX_SESSION_COUNT is rejected on read; findPausedSession collects it in `rejected` and never throws, so resume fails closed. Short stacks (>= 1) pass assertChips and reach createHand, whose own floor is $1 with all-in blinds (REQ-020.4), so removing the top-up opens no new input range. The new 'stopped' step cannot reach createHand with a 0 stack: nextStep returns 'stopped' before 'deal', dealHand throws on 'stopped', the hook's effect has no branch for it, and both nextHandDelay and dealAfterDone exclude sitAndGoStopped. A cash user on 0 maps to 'rebuy' and dealHand refuses it; rebuy and rebuyAndDeal now refuse at rebuys >= MAX_SESSION_COUNT, so a restored record at the cap cannot overflow the counter (closes the TASK-3.11 MINOR). MAX_SESSION_COUNT moved to session.ts and is re-exported unchanged. No new dependencies, secrets, logging or randomness changes.
